auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Outstanding payments as per NCLT in relation to operational creditors and public fixed deposit holders as on March 31, 2026. The Company has an outstanding amount payable of Rs. 57.73 lakhs as on March 31, 2026 pertaining to unsecured operational creditors & public fixed deposits. The Company has filed an application to the Hon'ble NCLT seeking directions for payments required to be made in relation to the outstanding amount standing in respect of such non traceable unsecured operational creditors & public fixed deposits in the books of accounts as on date vide their letter dated September 30, 2022.
